subtitle: about me
title: Get to Know My Story
description: I've been coding for over 5 years, across web and mobile. I like taking a messy problem and making it simple.

hero.body: I've worked on web and mobile for over 5 years, plus the backend behind them. I learn whatever tool the project needs. What doesn't change is how I work: understand the problem, build it, and stay to maintain it.
hero.body2: I started on the frontend and worked my way down the stack until I could take a product end to end, from the first screen to the database. These days I take loose ideas and hand back something people actually use. I'm based in Cape Town and work with clients here and abroad.
